photos.view: rear left three-quarter view at night, showing rear bumper corner and left rear quarter

vehicle_check.seen: silver three-door hatchback with rear spoiler

findings.reason: The left corner of the rear bumper cover is torn and crumpled, with broken fragments and a displaced edge by the wheel.
The lower rear quarter panel behind and above the wheel arch is deformed and scraped, with distortion near the bumper junction.

structural_reason: The impact at the rear corner crumpled the bumper and lower quarter panel, so the bumper reinforcement and rear body structure behind it may be affected.
